WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, score, risk_level, risk_type, scored_at FROM churn_score ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC ) SELECT l.user_id AS userId, u.name AS name, (um.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS isMember, l.score AS score, l.risk_level AS riskLevel, l.risk_type AS riskType, l.scored_at::date AS detectedAt, CASE WHEN ri.is_control IS NULL THEN 'SCHEDULED' WHEN ri.is_control THEN 'CONTROL' ELSE 'SENT' END AS status FROM latest l JOIN users u ON u.user_id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_membership WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ) um ON um.user_id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT is_control FROM retention_intervention ri WHERE ri.user_id = l.user_id AND ri.risk_type = l.risk_type ORDER BY ri.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) ri ON true
ORDER BY l.score DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.name AS name, u.email AS email, (um.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS isMember, u.created_at::date AS joinedAt, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_membership WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ) um ON um.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT g.risk_type AS riskType, l.source AS source, l.score AS latestScore, l.risk_level AS latestLevel, g.first_at AS firstDetectedAt, g.last_at AS lastDetectedAt, g.cnt AS detectCount, ri.created_at AS lastInterventionAt, CASE WHEN ri.created_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ri.is_control THEN 'CONTROL' WHEN io.converted THEN 'CONVERTED' ELSE 'NO_RESPONSE' END AS lastOutcome FROM ( SELECT risk_type, MIN(scored_at) AS first_at, MAX(scored_at) AS last_at, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM churn_score WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY risk_type ) g JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT score, risk_level, source FROM churn_score cs WHERE cs.user_id = #{userId} AND cs.risk_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM g.risk_type ORDER BY cs.scored_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) l ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ri.created_at, ri.is_control, ri.intervention_id FROM retention_intervention ri WHERE ri.user_id = #{userId} AND ri.risk_type = g.risk_type ORDER BY ri.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) ri ON true LEFT JOIN intervention_outcome io ON io.intervention_id = ri.intervention_id ORDER BY g.last_at DESC

SELECT ri.created_at AS createdAt, ri.risk_type AS riskType, ri.action_type AS actionType, ri.channel AS channel, ri.is_control AS isControl, CASE WHEN ri.is_control THEN 'CONTROL' WHEN io.converted THEN 'CONVERTED' ELSE 'NO_RESPONSE' END AS outcome FROM retention_intervention ri LEFT JOIN intervention_outcome io ON io.intervention_id = ri.intervention_id WHERE ri.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ri.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) AS totalSpent, COALESCE(AVG(total_price), 0)::bigint AS avgAmount, MAX(ordered_at) AS lastOrderedAt FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND payment_status = 'PAID'

WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, risk_level, risk_type FROM churn_score ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest l LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_membership WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ) um ON um.user_id = l.user_id
